angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,182,690 km at 208.94 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.7860 +/- 0.0272 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 208.94 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.7 +/- 0.12 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,182,690 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.96 +/- 0.5 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6304 +/- 49 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-3.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.269, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+41 2024: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-3 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.05 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-3 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.62523, from Mallonn et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...622A..81M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-3 (pscomppars): age 3 Gyr, from Knudstrup et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.379K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-3 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 7.2 km/s, from Knudstrup et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.379K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
